components.name: Action button
components.css: .ds-button { font: inherit; min-height:44px; padding:9px 14px; background:var(--paper,#fff); color:var(--ink,#20304e); border:1px solid var(--line,#bfcbd8); border-radius:5px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button:hover { background:#e3eaf5; border-color:var(--ink,#20304e); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a05000; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.48; }

components.name: A circle piece
components.description: Ownership by shape, label and color.
components.css: .ds-piece-a { position:relative; width:48px; height:48px; border:2px solid var(--a,#223c78); border-radius:50%; background:var(--a,#223c78); color:white; font:800 22px system-ui; } .ds-piece-a span { position:absolute; top:3px; left:0; width:100%; font-size:9px; } .ds-piece-a:hover { outline:2px solid #e9a32e; } .ds-piece-a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a05000; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: B square piece
components.css: .ds-piece-b { position:relative; width:48px; height:48px; border:2px solid var(--b,#126158); border-radius:5px; background:var(--b,#126158); color:white; font:800 22px system-ui; } .ds-piece-b span { position:absolute; top:3px; left:0; width:100%; font-size:9px; } .ds-piece-b:hover { outline:2px solid #e9a32e; } .ds-piece-b:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a05000; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Square-size input
components.description: Adjust board targets without shrinking below 44 pixels.
components.html: <label class="ds-zoom">Square size <input aria-label="Square size" type="range" min="44" max="72" value="48"></label>
components.css: .ds-zoom { font:12px system-ui; color:var(--ink,#20304e); } .ds-zoom input { width:100px; height:44px; accent-color:var(--ink,#20304e); vertical-align:middle; } .ds-zoom input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a05000; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Game navigation
components.html: 144 / Number strategyPrint the game kit
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:24px; justify-content:space-between; padding:20px 32px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#bfcbd8); font:14px system-ui; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--ink,#20304e); text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--a,#223c78); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a05000; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: This system describes the number-strategy app, not every future Gaming Lab project. The user approved a clean tabletop interface for casual phone pass-and-play and a matching large-print kit. A readable grid and explicit turn state carry the work; the interface uses no external typography or imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white surfaces and dark readable numbers.
A circles and B squares, labeled independently of color.
Touch-sized cells rather than a shrunken whole-board overview.
dos: Do keep owner letters and shapes alongside color.
Do preserve touch-sized cells and scroll navigation.
Do keep paper scale explicit and check the 100 mm bar.
donts: Don't shrink 144 cells into tiny phone touch targets.
Don't hide failed saves or failed offline setup.
Don't turn reference constants into decorative gameplay claims.
